Description: A sovereign government, state actor, or entity acting on behalf of a foreign nation.
A national government, its ministries, or official state organs acting within its own territory.
Formal military forces, command structures, or branches thereof.
Government agencies tasked with gathering and analyzing intelligence, including clandestine operations.
A non-state entity acting on behalf of a state or power to achieve its strategic objectives.
An organization that uses unlawful violence, intimidation, and terror against civilians to achieve political or ideological goals.
Entities involved in organized criminal activities, frequently acting for financial gain or as a cover for state-sponsored subversion.
A commercial business entity or industrial firm that may be used for economic influence or strategic asset subversion.
Non-governmental organizations; can be exploited for cultural influence, funding subversion, or as a diplomatic cover.
A single person acting independently or within a loose network, often used in grassroots subversion or disinformation.
Algorithms, bots, AI agents, or automated software used to scale disinformation, polarization, or cyber-attacks.
A threat actor whose identity, affiliation, or nature remains unidentified by current intelligence.
